title: Arahā
text: 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Sukhindriyaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ domanassindriyam upekhindriyaṃ || || 3. Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imesam pañcannam indriyānam samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto ti || ||
